Tofu cooking tips

Press for better texture

Press 10–15 minutes to remove excess water so tofu gets crispier and absorbs more flavor.

Freeze for a “meatier” bite

Freeze, thaw, then squeeze — it creates a chewier texture that soaks up marinades like a sponge.

Cornstarch = instant crisp

Lightly coat tofu before baking or pan-frying for a golden, crunchy exterior.

Go bold on seasoning

Tofu loves big flavor—use spices, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, or chili for maximum impact.

Don’t overcrowd the pan

Give tofu space so it browns instead of steaming.

Try crumbling it

Crumble tofu into “scrambles,” tacos, or pasta sauce for an easy, high-protein swap.
